deviations_from_card: New mount tests live in a new coupled file outcomes.test.tsx instead of layer2.test.tsx: adding them there pushed it to 480 lines and failed lint's check-size (limit 400). Bound printed as '95% 15%-85%' (percent, RateBar style). Small-sample mark is a muted Chip (no new CSS) to keep reconcile.l2 css under its 26,800 B line; Layer2.module.css gains one rule (.outcome). DirectivesPage reads reconcile.report via useReportId + useRpc directly (useReport would also fetch plan.proposals, an RPC the tab does not need); same query key, so cached with the Report tab.
notes: build rc=1 ONLY on check-bundle 'entry: js 294162 B > budget 291500 B', re-run after ~60s still red. Not mine: my strings ('Not judged in', 'retired directive') land only in the Layer2 lazy chunk; entry growth coincides with the uncommitted console-data-layer work in apps/console/src/data (mutations.ts etc). reconcile.l2 measured 85.3 KiB js / 26.1 KiB css, under its lines; no budget raised.
